specimen_type: Cervix, radical hysterectomy with pelvic lymphadenectomy

sections.Clinical details: Woman aged 44 years. A cervical growth was seen on speculum examination. She underwent radical hysterectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy.
sections.Specimen: Radical hysterectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy. Uterus with cervix, parametrial tissue and a cuff of upper vagina, together with pelvic lymph nodes from both sides (20 nodes in total).
sections.Gross description: Uterus and cervix with attached parametria and upper vaginal cuff. An ulcerated, fungating exophytic cervical mass with a greatest dimension of 32 mm. The vaginal cuff and both parametrial margins have been inked and sampled. Twenty pelvic lymph nodes are identified and submitted.
sections.Microscopic description: Sections show moderately differentiated non-keratinising squamous cell carcinoma infiltrating the cervical stroma to a depth of 11 mm. Lymphovascular invasion is present. Perineural invasion is not identified. The vaginal cuff and parametrial margins are free of tumour. Metastatic carcinoma is present in two of the 20 pelvic lymph nodes.
sections.Diagnosis:
Cervix, radical hysterectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy:
1. Invasive moderately differentiated non-keratinising squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix, 32 mm, with stromal invasion of 11 mm (pT1b2).
2. Metastatic carcinoma in two of 20 pelvic lymph nodes (pN1).
3. Lymphovascular invasion present; perineural invasion absent.
Pathological stage IIIC1p (AJCC 8th edition).
sections.Synoptic summary:
Tumour size: 32 mm (greatest dimension)
Histologic grade: Moderately differentiated (G2)
Margins: Clear (vaginal cuff and both parametria)
Lymphovascular invasion: Present
Perineural invasion: Absent
Lymph nodes (positive/total): 2/20
pT: pT1b2
pN: pN1
Staging edition: AJCC 8th edition
sections.Comment: The greatest tumour dimension of 32 mm places the tumour in pT1b2 (more than 2 cm and no more than 4 cm), so the T category is recorded as pT1b2 rather than pT1b1.
